title: [P0 Blocker] Final Submission ('InsertRequest') crashes with HTTP 500 (MDL_00_000) & Red Modal despite 100% valid relations (Husband, Son, Self)
description: [P0 Blocker] Final Submission ('InsertRequest') crashes with HTTP 500 (MDL_00_000) & Red Modal despite 100% valid relations (Husband, Son, Self):In New Registration, selecting Married with spouse linkage causes POST /ComSer/RequestMaster/InsertRequest to fail with HTTP 500. Developer assertion that this was caused by selecting 'Nephew' was refuted: re-tested with 100% valid relations (Member 5 = Husband, Member 4 = Son), and the API still crashed with HTTP 500. Decrypted response confirms unhandled backend/DB crash: ErrorCode: MDL_00_000, Language: en, Resource: SCD2.Common.Utilities.Resource.ErrorMessages.ErrorMessages_en (Message resource not found).
evidence: Preview screen with 'Failed' modal popup
DBeaver query showing 0 rows in TBL_COMMON_REQUEST_MASTER

title: Frontend State Loss
description: Frontend State Loss: Additional Married Member's Marriage Certificate Dropped from Final API Payload:When adding a second married member (e.g. Mohd Shoaib) with manual spouse entry and uploading a marriage certificate PDF, the Preview table visually indicates the document is attached. However, the outgoing InsertRequest JSON payload completely omits the document from DocumentRequestModels (only HoF's document is included), causing backend validation failure due to missing mandatory marriage document.
evidence: 'Spouse Details - Married' modal showing PDF attached
Decrypted InsertRequest payload showing only 1 document in DocumentRequestModels

title: Aadhaar Unmask Eye Icon Completely Unresponsive on Mobile & Touch Devices
description: Aadhaar Unmask Eye Icon Completely Unresponsive on Mobile & Touch Devices:On mobile browsers (iOS/Android) and touch emulation, tapping the Eye icon (fa-eye) next to 'Enter Aadhaar or VID' fails to unmask the digits. Angular bundle analysis reveals the button only listens to desktop mouse events (mousedown/mouseup/mouseleave) and completely lacks mobile touch event handlers (touchstart/touchend) or a click-toggle state.
evidence: Mobile view (iPhone emulation) showing unmask eye icon unresponsive
Decompiled chunk code showing only mousedown/mouseup listeners

description: UI / Content - Redundant Duplicate Eligibility Criteria Displayed in 'Eligibility' Instruction Card:On the Family Registration instructions page, the Eligibility / पात्रता card repeats the exact same age rule twice: Point 1 ('The head of the family must be 18 years of age or above') and Point 2 ('Only a person aged 18 years or above may apply as the head of the family'). title: Silent Validation & Missing Error Message on Parent Hindi Names
description: Silent Validation & Missing Error Message on Parent Hindi Names:The input fields for Father's and Mother's Name (In Hindi) permit entering leading dots and full stops ('. . . ..'). While an underlying regex validator flags full stops as invalid, the UI displays ZERO inline error feedback ('Special characters not allowed'). As a result, the Angular form becomes silently invalid, and clicking 'Add Member' does nothing with no indication of what field failed. Entering clean names without full stops allows submission to succeed.
evidence: media_1793620801108_7c3e32d8.png (Father Hindi name showing . . . ..अंग्रज)
session_step2.har (Network log showing 0 HTTP calls on click)

title: Zero Backend Validation & Sanitization on Hindi Demographic Name Fields
description: Zero Backend Validation & Sanitization on Hindi Demographic Name Fields:The backend .NET API (DrtAddMember) performs zero validation or sanitization on FatherNameHi and MotherNameHi fields. It permitted over 250 characters of arbitrary English prose ('Steps to Reproduce: Proceed to Step 1...') containing punctuation, English alphabets, and quotes to be saved directly into the database without rejection or sanitization.
evidence: GetTempFamilyDetail decrypted JSON response showing 250+ char English bug text in FatherNameHi
